sloka: त्वत्कृते तमनिद्रा च शोकश्चिन्ता च राघवम् ।तापयन्ति महात्मानमग्न्यागारमिवाग्नयः ।। ५.३५.४५।।।।
transliteration: tvatkṛte tamanidrā ca śokaścintā ca rāghavam ।tāpayanti mahātmānamagnyāgāramivāgnayaḥ ।। 5.35.45।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is burning like a furnace by (three fires) sleeplessness, grief and intense anxiety just as the three sacred fires keep a firesanctuary intensely heated.
